title: Naringenin alleviates age-related bone loss by targeting Runx2.
authors: Sun, Chuanxin; He, Yuke; Xiao, Fu; Chen, Chang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物Naringenin通过直接结合成骨转录因子Runx2缓解老年性骨丢失，虽以TF-DNA互作机制为核心，但方法以湿实验为主，仅含分子动力学模拟，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Senile osteoporosis presents a significant and growing health burden. Currently, no pharmacological agents are specifically approved for this condition. The dietary flavonoid naringenin (NAR) exhibits osteoprotective potential; however, its efficacy and direct molecular target in the context of senile osteoporosis remain undefined. EXPERIMENTAL APPROACH: The effects of NAR were evaluated in a natural ageing mouse model by assessing skeletal mass, microstructure and strength. In vivo analyses included bone histomorphometry, serum bone turnover marker assays and biomechanical testing. Osteogenic and osteoclastogenic differentiation was examined in cell cultures. To identify the molecular target of NAR, we employed RNA sequencing, siRNA transfection, biotin-conjugated pull-down assays, molecular dynamics simulations, competitive pull-down with immunoblotting, SPR, CETSA, DARTS and western blotting. KEY RESULTS: NAR treatment significantly increased bone mineral density, improved trabecular microarchitecture and enhanced bone strength in ageing mice. It promoted bone formation, elevated the mineral apposition and bone formation rates and concurrently suppressed osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption. In vitro, NAR enhanced osteogenic differentiation and mineralization. Mechanistically, NAR directly bound to the key osteogenic transcription factor Runx2 and activated Runx2-dependent gene expression. Silencing Runx2 markedly attenuated the osteogenic effects of NAR. CONCLUSION AND IMPLICATIONS: These findings demonstrate that NAR promotes bone formation while limiting resorption, thereby alleviating age-related bone loss by activating Runx2. This study identifies Runx2 as a direct molecular target of NAR and supports its potential use in the management of senile osteoporosis.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：老年性骨质疏松症构成重大且日益增长的健康负担。目前，尚无药物被专门批准用于该病症。膳食黄酮类化合物柚皮素（naringenin, NAR）显示出骨保护潜力；然而，其在老年性骨质疏松症中的疗效及直接分子靶点仍未明确。实验方法：在自然衰老小鼠模型中评估NAR的效果，通过检测骨骼质量、微结构和强度进行评价。体内分析包括骨组织形态计量学、血清骨转换标志物测定及生物力学测试。在细胞培养中检测成骨和破骨细胞分化。为鉴定NAR的分子靶点，我们采用了RNA测序、siRNA转染、生物素偶联pull-down实验、分子动力学模拟、竞争性pull-down结合免疫印迹、SPR、CETSA、DARTS及western blotting。关键结果：NAR处理显著增加了衰老小鼠的骨矿物质密度，改善了骨小梁微结构并增强了骨强度。它促进了骨形成，提高了矿物质沉积率和骨形成率，同时抑制了破骨细胞分化和骨吸收。在体外，NAR增强了成骨分化和矿化。机制上，NAR直接结合关键成骨转录因子Runx2并激活Runx2依赖性基因表达。沉默Runx2显著减弱了NAR的成骨效应。结论与意义：这些发现表明，NAR通过激活Runx2促进骨形成同时限制骨吸收，从而缓解年龄相关骨丢失。本研究将Runx2鉴定为NAR的直接分子靶点，并支持其在老年性骨质疏松症管理中的潜在应用。
